newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police detain extremists suspected of arson.
newsitem.headline: German police detain extremists suspected of arson.

text.p: German police said on Sunday they had detained two suspected right-wing extremists in connection with the firebombing of a swastika-daubed building where a group of Italian guest workers were living.
A spokesman for the state police said they had detained an 18-year-old and a 20-year-old after fire damaged the entrance to the building in Dresden early on Saturday.
No one was hurt in the blaze. The building was unoccupied at the time of the attack.
Authorities found swastikas painted on the building and said witnesses reported that the suspected attackers had shouted Nazi slogans shortly after the fire started.
